■ Direction

---
★ Request
Display Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi (Summer Uniform).
Clenches fists.
――Yes!!
Huh――?!

You told me that working hard also means knowing when to rest...
Even so. But still――...

...――Y-Yes!!
I'll give it everything I've got!! So――!
Eep?! Ah, umm...

...So, Trainer. If during today's training I do
super well, and show you a run full of promise――

『Yes! Because I spend much more time thinking than other girls do!
And besides that, I've been thinking about all sorts of... *yaaawn*――』

B-But I'm sorry! I understand!
I shouldn't push myself when I'm not feeling well. Especially with my frail constitution!

――Oh, but this is great timing! I can make use of waking up early!
I didn't get to train yesterday either, so...!

A-At first, it just happened by chance. Since my body is frailer than normal.
I lacked stamina. I wasn't good at sleeping. And I began waking up at strange early hours.
――Y-Yes!!

『I-I'm sorry. Ehehe,
as we were chatting about all sorts of things, I suddenly got so... hehe...』
...Huh, Bright-san? What do you mean by "we"...?
Huh. Improvement proposals――... Whoa.

...Trainer, my body is weak. I have to take breaks
sometimes. And I end up "falling a lap behind" everyone else.

――I'm prepared for that. As one of the people who showed her the way forward, I'll see this through.
Even if we both step away from racing someday, I'll be someone she can always lean on.

My body feels lighter than it has in days!
If I run like this, I'm sure I'll set a great time.
――Right after finishing the run, we signed a trainer contract with the vow: "Let's aim for the Triple Crown."
Just like everyone else moving forward――I want to get closer to my own finish line, too.

...Trainer. When did you make all these materials?
From tips on eating noodles to stretches for aiding digestion...!

She's fast asleep.
I'm certain today... she won't wake up until morning.

...I just didn't want to stop.
Even if I was doing it all wrong... I wanted to do my best.
『Umm, Twainer-san... I'll do mah besht...――』
『Trainer-san?!』

Today... is the day?
...I suppose it is.

Besides, with all the rest she had to take, she must have spent a lot of time studying on her own.
All without having much chance to be taught "what she should actually learn."

Whoa-gah?! H-H-H-How did you find out...?! 
Was it Bright-san?! Or was it El-chan and the others?!
...You knew about everything, didn't you?

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's proposed "Operation Tsuyoshi Eats 10 Bowls of Ramen!".
Her enthusiasm is commendable... but there are still plenty of holes in that plan.

Could we sign an official contract today?
...With me as the Umamusume under your wing.

It is quite all right.
We simply woke up because we wished to, that is all.

Still, I don't want to give up on trying hard. I don't want to stop.
If you can teach me the right way to train, I want to keep moving forward with that.
Pfft?! *cough* *pant*............ Whoa. 3 AM again...

――Bright-san?!
I'm so sorry, did I wake you again――

More, faster! Faster!!
Don't stop!! Squeeze out every drop!! ――...Push through!!
...Tsuru-chan-sama.

...Trainer-sama.
Tsuru-chan-sama is sound asleep~.

...I have no intention of running from that responsibility. Going forward,
I will be guiding a girl whose frail body makes a racing career perilous down a thorny path.
――...I have you by my side.

Without a clear guideline, gathering whatever information she could find,
pushing herself as hard as possible. Running frantically all on her own.

Finally seeing her run with my own eyes, it was truly wonderful.
It filled me with genuine promise.

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi is an un-debuted Umamusume.
She has never had a dedicated trainer before.
No way!! H-How? Bright-sa... Aaagh...

Unfolding the letter given by Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, I lay out my materials.
...It's been a while since I've read nutritional science books this thoroughly.

The smartphone sitting on the desk starts vibrating.
I pick it up and gently press the answer button.
...Ngh, ――I'm not done yet. Not nearly. More.
(Those two, as well...)
(*chime*)

(...Incredible. All three of them have gotten faster again.
No... not just the "three" of them.)

The plan for the day was set. Head to the track with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
And so, she took her position, calmed her breathing, and honed her focus――

Wah, ah, aah!! Trainer-san!!
!! I'm so sorry about today――

『So, Trainer-san, I was hoping to try
training in a flowing pool, too! It puts less strain on the body!』
*pant*... *pant*... *gasp*...!! Faster――!!
